name: Window AC units
tagline: All-in-one cooling that fits a wall or window opening
description: A single-box air conditioner that's affordable, quick to install and needs no separate outdoor unit.
long_description: A window AC houses the compressor, condenser, evaporator and fans in one cabinet that sits in a window or wall opening, with the hot side facing outdoors. There's no refrigerant piping to run, so installation is fast and the unit is easy to remove or replace. Modern inverter window ACs are noticeably more efficient than older fixed-speed models.
use_case: Bedrooms, rented homes and small offices
features: Single unit, with no outdoor unit or piping to install
Lower purchase and installation cost than a split AC
Easy to remove, relocate or replace
Inverter models available for lower running costs

specs.label: Installation
specs.value: Window or wall opening with a support frame

variants.suits: Rooms up to about 120 sq ft

considerations: Needs a window or a wall opening with the back exposed to open air
Louder indoors than a split, because the compressor is in the same box
We can make a neat wall cut-out and frame if there's no suitable window

faqs.question: Window AC or split AC?
faqs.answer: A window AC is cheaper and quicker to install. A split AC is quieter and more flexible about where the indoor unit goes.

faqs.question: Can you install a window AC without a window?
faqs.answer: Yes, through an external wall. We cut and frame the opening and seal it afterwards.
